title: SendGrid returns 200 instead of 202 and no email is delivered
symptoms: Mail Send responds 200 OK, not 202 Accepted
Nothing in Email Activity and no Event Webhook events
400 The sandbox mode enable param should be a boolean value
cause: With mail_settings.sandbox_mode.enable true, SendGrid only validates the request and returns 200, and the message is never delivered. A flag left on from tests, or a string true, causes silent non-delivery or a 400.
fix: Drive sandbox mode from an explicit test flag, send a real boolean, and treat a 200 from Mail Send in production as an alarm.
apply: mail_settings: { sandbox_mode: { enable: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' } }  // expect 202 in production
affected: SendGrid v3 Mail Send, as of 2026-10
